document.abstract: This report of the Progress Committee covers the year 1937. The advances in the cinematographic art are classified as follows: (I) Cinematography: (A) Professional and (B) Substandard; (II) Sound Recording; (III) Sound and Picture Reproduction; (IV) Publications and New Books; (Appendix) The Japanese Motion Picture Industry; Progress in Germany; Progress in Great Britain.
